subject: ALTERNATE RECORD KEY clause
notes: cite.py --check 12.4.5.6.4 "are implicitly referenced as keys for all other record description entries of that file" -> OK GR5. Keys are registered as a byte WINDOW (offset,length) over the shared record area, so every record description of the FD is keyed at those positions by construction. Probe gr5.cob: FD with 01 R (R-ALT at bytes 3-5) and 01 S; records WRITTEN THROUGH S are indexed on bytes 3-5 (READ KEY IS R-ALT "CCC" finds the S-written record 02; a second S-written record with the same bytes 3-5 -> '22'; the START/READ NEXT walk orders S-written and R-written records by those bytes). The covering test writes through REC-A and STARTs by a sibling-record operand at the same byte position, expected record derived from the spec.
